subject.title: fix(test): stop Knip SIGTERM cleanup check from flaking

question: Should this protected maintainer-labelled test-flake fix be landed after its merge review is refreshed against current `main`?
rationale: Repository policy keeps items with the `maintainer` label out of automated cleanup even when the patch appears correct; a human should confirm the final merge result and current checks.

options.title: Refresh and merge
options.body: Re-evaluate the rebased merge result and land if the focused cleanup test and required checks remain green.

options.title: Pause for broader flake evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers want additional CI recurrence evidence before accepting the small polling helper.

recommendation.title: Refresh and merge
